en: The image shows the back of a vintage postcard. The postcard is addressed to someone in Barcelona, Spain. It features a handwritten address, a Spanish postage stamp, and a postmark in the upper right corner. The text 'TARJETA POSTAL' (Spanish for 'Postcard'), 'UNIÓN POSTAL UNIVERSAL', and 'ESPAÑA' are printed at the top, indicating it is from Spain. The lower left corner reads 'COLECCIÓN “LAURENT” MADRID.'
